limitations_and_boundaries: The method is demonstrated on synthetic data, benchmark discrete datasets, and a protein signaling network; generalizability to other domains is not fully assessed.
The autoencoder architecture may be too simple to approximate multinomial distributions well, as indicated by BIC score gaps on discrete benchmarks.
The acyclicity constraint variant (polynomial) is proposed for practical convenience but may have different numerical properties compared to matrix exponential.
The method assumes faithfulness between the DAG and the joint distribution.
The continuous optimization approach may converge to stationary points rather than global optima.
